## v5.2.1 — the catch-up reads everything waiting for you

`slack_catch_me_up` now reads the whole conversation list and Slack's own unread badges.

Until now it read only the first 200 conversations Slack lists, and it judged what was waiting by the list's unread number, which drops to zero once you open a channel and never counts mentions. A profile with no channels, the "catch me up on everything" setup, could come back empty while messages were waiting. On a live workspace it read 0 conversations before this fix and 5 after, and four of those five never appear in Slack's list at all.

### Fixed

- A channel your profile names is read wherever it sits in the list.
- A profile with no channels reads every conversation with unread messages or a mention, mentions first, including the ones only Slack's badges know about.
- A named channel that still cannot be read appears in `scope.channels_not_found` with the reason, so its silence is never mistaken for a quiet channel.
- `scope.listing` says how much of the list was read and why the scan stopped.

### Compatibility

The 20 tools and their schemas are unchanged. In the catch-up response, `truncation.caps` replaces `conversationScanLimit` with `listingPageSize` and `listingMaxPages`. Requires Node 20 or later.

### Install

```sh
npx -y @jtalk22/slack-mcp@latest --setup
```

Full changelog: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/jtalk22/slack-mcp-server/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#521---2026-11-03)
